title: Sunday Brunch
description: Sacro's weekly Sunday brunch, which the restaurant is reminding followers about for this weekend.

title: Domingos en el Sofá: Daytime Latin American Selections by DJ Hernia
description: A daytime DJ set by Caracas hip hop veteran DJ Hernia at La Berta's sofa, part of a monthly Sunday series that runs until December 13, 2026.

title: L'Altra Bolgheri: I Luoghi wine dinner
description: A 20-seat shared dinner with five vintages poured at the table, hosted with Stefano Granata and Paola De Fusco aka I Luoghi, at €75 per person.

title: Vini Dumatt Wine Tasting at La Berta
description: A wine tasting featuring Dumatt wines, with the winemakers Viviana and Michela sharing their work, the bar pouring only Dumatt wines with discounts, and a kitchen menu paired with each wine, including vegetarian and vegan options.

title: Corso Corsaro Extra - Aging Wines Tasting with Alessio (APEwineboxes)
description: A Tuesday evening wine tasting at Solovino with Alessio of APEwineboxes, opening aged bottles to explore where the value of a wine that can wait lies, for 50 € with at least 6 wines and a closing dish.

title: À Table: Frissón hosts Terso
description: A dinner dedicated to discovery and sharing, where Terso, a young culinary destination from Molise, brings a selection of local regional products to Frissón, paired with fine wines.

title: A Full Pie of Guests (ep. 1) - Special Menu with maneroburger
description: The first monthly guest-chef special menu, featuring maneroburger, with a fried course, a pizza, and a dessert, reservations via DM.

title: Campagne Romane: Roman Countryside Dinner
description: Osteria Iotto cooks with produce from Matilde Coltiva, paired with Gazzetta wines, for an evening celebrating the Roman countryside at Vinificio; reservations via DM or the link in bio.

title: Giovedì Bolle: Bortolotti Sparkling Wine Pairing
description: An evening at Sacro in Rome pairing four Bortolotti sparkling wines from Valdobbiadene with two dishes each, with reservations at 347 782 2805.

title: Troppo Frizzante feat. Cantina Ribelà
description: A wine and vinyl evening at Semi di Vino with Cantina Ribelà's wines, a vinyl DJ set, and the restaurant's dishes.

title: Alonso & Pedrajo x Para Compartir: Wine Pairing Dinner
description: A three-course dinner with three paired wines from the Rioja region of Spain, presented in an exclusive national debut, for 40 € per person.

title: Il Guercio Vertical Tasting with Sean O'Callaghan
description: A vertical tasting of all eight vintages of Il Guercio from Tenuta di Carleone, from 2017 to 2024, presented by winemaker Sean O'Callaghan and paired with a four-course menu (130 € per person, bookings to be announced).

title: Soul and Blues with Lopez e Strina
description: A Soul and Blues night featuring Lopez e Strina at The Barber Shop Speakeasy, with table bookings available through the website.

title: Ruvido goes to Barro
description: Ruvido brings its à la carte menu to Barro in Via Carlo Pisacane 14 for a joint evening, with Barro pouring the wine and Ruvido cooking the food.

title: Tu Sei Balera: Sunday Lunch with DJ Set, Burraco and Cotillion
description: A slow Sunday lunch at La Berta with traditional food, wine, old-school dance music from DJ Tatiana (Non-DJ Selecta), a burraco tournament, prizes and cotillion, with free entry and no reservation needed (burraco requires booking).

title: Santini x Glory Pop: Pizza, Trippa & Rock'n'Roll
description: A four-hands dinner with Glory Pop from Milan, featuring a tasting menu in courses that showcases pizza in all its forms for €55.

title: Panettone Tasting Day with Lievitati Lenti & 33Giri
description: A relaxed Sunday at 33Giri with three artisanal panettoni to taste, a savory surprise, records by Carlo Scordo, and panettoni available to take home.
